header: How to request data not in the portal
lead: Everything from 2013 onwards can be downloaded without asking. Sediment cores, lab sheets and paper records from before 2013 cannot, so here is how to request them.

steps.title: Check the portal first
steps.text: About half of all requests are for data that is already published under another name. The station index lists every name we have used.

steps.title: Write to the data desk
steps.text: Send one email saying what you need, the period and what you plan to do with it. Your plan helps us choose a suitable format.

steps.title: Wait two working days
steps.text: Simple requests get a link. Requests that need laboratory time get a date instead, usually four to six weeks later.

steps.title: Credit the series
steps.text: Every export includes the series ID. Cite it, not only the institute, so readers of your work can find the same numbers.
